title: Processor
body:
CPU - runs the program 
GPU- is a brain 

The processor fetches an instruction, decodes it, executes it, and repeats. That loop is the
only thing it does, and everything else in the degree is layered on top of it.

The fact that matters here: **machine language is different for every processor**, so a
compiled `a.out` runs on the machine it was built for and nowhere else. That is the trade
[[Compiling]] makes against [[Interpriting|interpreting]], which ships source and translates on
whatever machine it lands on.

Taken apart properly in [[COMPUTING MACHINERY]]: [[CPU]], [[Machine Language]],
[[Instructions]], registers, the fetch-execute cycle, and the [[Cache]] between the processor
and memory.
